    (hpt : Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q))
    (hgx : ∀ n, g (x n)  = p n) (hgy : g y = q) :
    ContinuousOn g ({y} ∪ Set.range x)

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_add (a b c : ℝ) (p q : I) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hac : a < c) :
    (interpolate a c p q b).1 + (interpolate a c q p b).1 = p.1 + q

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_continuousOn
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_continuousOn (a c : ℝ) (p q : I) :
    ContinuousOn (interpolate a c p q) (Set.Icc a c)

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_dist
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_dist {a b x y : ℝ} {p q : I} (hab : a < b)
    (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) (hay : a ≤ y) (hyb : y ≤ b) :
    dist (interpolate a b p q x) (interpolate a b p q y) =
    |q.1 - p.1| / (b - a) * (dist x y)

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_dist_left
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_dist_left {a b x : ℝ} {p q : I} (hab : a < b)
    (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) :
    dist p (interpolate a b p q x) =
    |q.1 - p.1| / (b - a) * dist x a

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_dist_right
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_dist_right {a b x : ℝ} {p q : I} (hab : a < b)
    (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) :
    dist (interpolate a b p q x) q =
    |q.1 - p.1| / (b - a) * dist x b

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_le_max
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_le_max (a b c : ℝ) (p q : I) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hac : a < c) :
    interpolate a c p q b ≤ max p q

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_left (a b : ℝ) (p q : I) (hab : a < b) :
    (interpolate a b p q) a = p

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_mem
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_mem {a b c : ℝ} (p q : I) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hac : a < c) :
    (q.1 - p.1) / (c - a) * (b - a) + p.1 ∈ I

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_right (a b : ℝ) (p q : I) (hab : a < b) :
    (interpolate a b p q) b = q

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.interpolate_self (a b c : ℝ) (p : I) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hac : a < c) :
    interpolate a c p p b = p

Tengoku.LeanTnorms.correction_add
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.correction_add (x : ℕ → X) (y : X) (p : I) (q : I) (a : ℝ)
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hx : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y)) :
    (correction x y p q a).1  = (correction1 x y p a).1 + (correction2 q a).1

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.dist_fun_add_compactSupport
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.dist_fun_add_compactSupport {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} (p : ℕ → I) (q : I) (a : ℝ) :

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.dist_fun_compactSupport_apply_dist

lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.dist_fun_compactSupport_apply_dist {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I} (n : ℕ)

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.dist_fun_compactSupport_eqOn_interpolate_Icc
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.dist_fun_compactSupport_eqOn_interpolate_Icc {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I} (n : ℕ)

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.exists_match_fun_of_exists_accPt_unitInterval
statement:
lemma Tengoku.LeanTnorms.exists_match_fun_of_exists_accPt_unitInterval
    (h : ∃ x, AccPt x (⊤ : Filter X)) :
    ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : I, ∀ p : ℕ → I, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → I,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)

statement:

    (h : ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : I, ∀ p : ℕ → I, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → I,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)) :
    ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : M, ∀ p : ℕ → M, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → M,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)

name: Tengoku.LeanTnorms.exists_match_fun_of_uniformEquiv_unitInterval
